Additionally, the reply says nothing about the soccer practice already on Saturday at 10am (Cedarvale Park), which is relevant context — though that is a minor omission compared to dropping the standing place entirely. The reply is not wrong in what it says, but it fails to deliver the one thing it had: a real, verified option for Saturday.
